question: Related Questions Q. I have just completed the Tarabih salat behind a Hafej Saheb. He did not demanded any money from us but we voluntarily collected some money within ourselves and handed over the same to him. He has accepted the money. I heard that taking money in any form is not allowed in Islam after reciting the Quran in tarabih. Kindly tell me what is the islamic guidance in details in this regards. 1.Should we avoid performing tarabih salat behind a hafij who ask for money or take money when given voluntarily. 2.Is it allowed to give money to a hafij who recite Quran on Tarabih on account of his recitation of Quran. 3.If we don't get a hafij who recite Quran in tarabih without taking or asking money what shouod we do then? 2921 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 9717 Country: India Title: i want to know about the kasar salat. please send me the answer of my question. please define also km of kasar salat. Question: i want to know about the kasar salat. please send me the answer of my question. please define also km of kasar salat. Answer ID: 9717 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2583/2063=H/1429) What do you want to ask? You should write it specifically. The distance as per the Shariah should be 77.25 km from the outskirts of the city you travel to your destination. If one is intending to travel to such distance or more, one will be called musafir. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
